retrievalProfile.description: A classic 1980s studio portrait featuring a male subject against a vibrant red gradient with bold, metallic-styled interlocking typography.
triggerTerms: soft focus male portrait with beard
excludeWhen: minimalist or flat design is required
outdoor or natural light settings are specified

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up of a man with dark, feathered hair and a full beard, wearing a black shirt and a gold medallion necklace, set against a warm red-to-dark-red radial gradient. The composition is anchored by a complex, metallic-textured logo in the top left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's dark hair and clothing provide a heavy base against the vibrant red background.
The gold medallion and metallic logo create a visual triangle of highlights.
The soft, diffused lighting on the face contrasts with the sharp, hard-edged graphic elements.
coreInvariants: Soft-focus studio lighting with gentle highlights on the forehead and nose
Upper-left placement for primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered and occupies the bottom two-thirds of the frame, cropped at the mid-chest.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the large metallic logo in the upper left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bright logo in the top left, down to the subject's face, then following the gold chain to the medallion.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper right and around the head, filled by the red gradient.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with low-value, high-texture darks in the subject.

letterConstructionRules: Thick, blocky serifs with rounded terminals
Extravagant swashes on initial and terminal letters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are nested within each other to create a compact, badge-like silhouette

treatment.outline: thick black and thin gold double stroke

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A complex, heavy decorative logo paired with a wide-tracked, minimalist italic sans-serif for contrast.

preserve: Wide letter spacing for the subtitle
avoid: Flat, single-color fills for the logo

candidateDirections.reason: Similar weight and serif structure for the base

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man with 1980s feathered hair and a beard, wearing a black shirt and gold medallion, against a red radial gradient background. Leave the top left corner clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a custom interlocking metallic logo in the top left with a gold-to-silver gradient and thick black outlines. Below it, add a single line of wide-spaced, italicized sans-serif text separated by thin gold lines.

verificationChecks: Is the background a smooth red gradient?
Does the logo have a metallic, beveled appearance?
Is the subtitle text widely tracked and italicized?
Is the lighting on the subject soft and diffused?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the metallic bevel on the text
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Exact logo shape and interlocking pattern
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the gold medallion has a realistic metallic sheen
Verify the red gradient doesn't have banding
Confirm the subject's hair has a soft, feathered texture
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Red Radial Gradient + Interlocking Metallic Display Type + Wide-Tracked Subtitle
